name: ACP Internal Medicine Meeting 2027
description: The ACP Internal Medicine Meeting 2027 is the annual scientific and educational conference of the American College of Physicians, held in Los Angeles, California. It includes clinical education sessions, pre courses, and the ACP National Abstract Competitions for medical students, residents, fellows, and associates.
